request:
Author only the minimum missing native Foil fragment, not an app or UI. Existing Shrine material already has editable record fields, exact subject references, field presentations, native actions and two temporal presentations that will reuse this fragment. A task is a myth with opaque slots ['deadline] (pails/n day number), ['estimate] (pails/n duration), ['title] (pails/t), ['owner] (pails/p). We need a reusable Task -> Interval projection. Mode "estimate" uses [deadline-estimate,deadline]; mode "deadline" uses [deadline,deadline]. Missing or mistyped values must be errors; never silently coerce or use zero. An estimate preceding day 0 must be an error. Unknown mode must be an error. No host code, no effects, no namespace reads, no UI, no new framework.
Return a single ordinary Grove source unit with this structure and signatures:
projection =
  ! foil
  + interval
    : start=nat end=nat
  + apply
    \ card=myth mode=str
    ^ either[str projection/interval]
    ...
Foil examples:
?> (./some held) card.get(['deadline]) (./err "Deadline unknown.")
?> deadline=pails/n held (./err "Wrong type.")
? (eq mode "deadline") (./ok (projection/interval deadline.n deadline.n))
? (gt estimate.n deadline.n) (./err "Before origin.")
| ./ok (projection/interval (sub deadline.n estimate.n) deadline.n)
Do not use blank lines inside the ! foil block. Return JSON with keys source (string) and rationale (string).

projection =
  ! foil
  + interval
    : start=nat end=nat
  + apply
    \ card=myth mode=str
    ^ either[str projection/interval]
    ?> (./some held-d) card.get(['deadline]) (./err "Deadline unknown.")
    ?> deadline=pails/n held-d (./err "Wrong type.")
    ? (eq mode "deadline") (./ok (projection/interval deadline.n deadline.n))
    ?! (eq mode "estimate") (./err "Unknown mode.")
    ?> (./some held-e) card.get(['estimate]) (./err "Estimate unknown.")
    ?> estimate=pails/n held-e (./err "Wrong type.")
    ? (gt estimate.n deadline.n) (./err "Before origin.")
    | ./ok (projection/interval (sub deadline.n estimate.n) deadline.n)
